description: This Java class 'DefaultEdqsService' implements the 'EdqsService' interface, managing EDQS synchronization, state, and event processing within the Thingsboard platform. It handles startup routines, system requests, message processing, and state updates related to EDQS.

classes.name: DefaultEdqsService
classes.description: Service class managing EDQS synchronization, state, and event processing within Thingsboard.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes executor services, producer, lock, and state after construction.

methods.name: onStartUp
methods.description: Performs startup routines, schedules periodic checks, and initiates sync process.

methods.name: requestEdqsSync
methods.description: Requests an EDQS synchronization if the current node is the system partition.

methods.name: processSystemRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming system requests for EDQS.

methods.name: processSystemMsg
methods.description: Processes incoming system messages asynchronously, updating state and handling sync logic.

methods.name: broadcastEdqsReady
methods.description: Broadcasts EDQS readiness status to other nodes.

methods.name: onEdqsReady
methods.description: Updates internal state based on EDQS readiness.

methods.name: checkState
methods.description: Evaluates and updates the overall EDQS API enablement and mode based on current state.

methods.name: isApiEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the EDQS API is enabled.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Handles update events for entities, filtering by supported types.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Handles delete events for entities, filtering by supported types.

methods.name: processEvent
methods.description: Sends an EDQS event message for update or delete events.

methods.name: isEdqsType
methods.description: Checks if the entity type is supported for EDQS.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts messages to other nodes via cluster service.

methods.name: getSyncState
methods.description: Retrieves the current sync state from attributes.

methods.name: saveSyncState
methods.description: Saves the current sync state to attributes.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down executor services and stops the producer.
